blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan – Councilor Blesildo Sumera assumed the mayoralty seat of Urdaneta City on Monday after taking his oath of office on Friday. Sumera’s ascension to mayor followed the Office of the Ombudsman’s dismissal of Mayor Julius “Rammy” Parayno and Vice Mayor Jimmy Parayno for “grave misconduct.” They defied a 2025 Palace suspension order that stemmed from the indefinite suspension of the president of the Liga ng mga Barangay. Vice Mayor Rico Esteves also took the oath of office last Friday, replacing Jimmy Parayno.
